notes: ZO-Mix 1.0.28: System health shows where a delay comes from (the console, ZO-Mix, or a device's Wi-Fi) and keeps a log you can send us. Per musician: which mixes they can open. Player groups now holds a musician's whole screen (Player channels is gone), and channels can be dragged into place inside a group. The show clock stops by itself. ZO-Mix is in the Dock. What's new shows on Setup. A beta for Intel Macs.
